## User Story

**As a** developer  
**I want** a hybrid LLM router  
**So that** simple tasks use Ollama locally and complex tasks escalate to cloud

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `stem/llm/router.py` with `HybridRouter` class
- [ ] Routes based on offline flag, complexity heuristic, cost
- [ ] Config in `stem/config/settings.py` (default model per provider)
- [ ] Test: simple prompt → Ollama, complex → Claude

## Story Points

**Estimate:** 5
